page.layout: One printed page. Main text in one column of italic Latin verse lines, with a narrow column of marginal notes on the left margin (side-notes beside the verse). Running head at top; page number at top left. Below the verse, a single line "Italia" at the lower right, as the last line of the text block.

p.i: Arduus inde Agragas ostentat maxima longè
Mœnia, magnanimum quondam generator equorum.
Tèque datis linquo ventis palmosa Selinis:
Et vada dura lego saxis Libyæa cæcis.
Hinc Drepani me portus, & illæ abilis hora
Accipit hic, pelagi tot tempestatibus æstus.
Curio Sicanias transcendere iussus in vrbes
Quà mare tellurem subitis aut obruit vndis,
Aut scidit, & medias fecit sibi littora terras.
Vis illic ingens pelagi, semperque laborant
Æquora, ne rupti repetant confinia montes.
Bellàque Sardoas etiam sparguntur in oras.
Vtraque frugiferis est insula nobilis aruis.
Nec plus Hesperiam longinquis messibus vlla,
Nec Romana magis complerunt horrea terra:
Vbere vix glebæ superat, cessantibus austris,
Cùm medium nubes, Borea cogente, sub axem
Effusis magnum Libya tulit imbribus annum.
Quorum Acragantinus cum primis Empedocles est:
Insula quem triquetris terrarum gessit in oris:
Quam fluitans circum magnis anfractibus æquor,
Ionium glaucis aspergit littus ab vndis:
Italia terrai oras à finibus eius:
Hic tamen est vasta Charybdis: & hic Ætnæa mi-
nantur
Murmura flammarum rursum se conligere iras:
Faucibus eruptos iterum vt vis enomat ignes:
Ad cælúmque ferat flammai fulgura rursum:
Qua cum magna modis multis miranda videtur
Gentibus humanis regio, visendáque fertur,
Rebus opima bonis, multa munita virùm vi.
Æthera deseruit, Siculásque relegat in oras
Ingenio confisa loci. Trinacria quondam
Italia

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left margin are transcribed beside their verse lines; their exact line placement is approximate. The word "Italia" at the lower right is a catchword-like line of text and is kept as the last line. Several words in the verse are uncertain, e.g. "semperque", "Siculásque", "miranda", and are transcribed as printed; the small left-margin note for Siciliæ is partly cut off. Scan is slightly skewed at the right edge.
